content.title: Ensemble Focus Relay | Group Rhythm to Lead and Back
content.summary: Establish the full ensemble and its shared rhythm, bring two central contributors into one action, then isolate one lead long enough to complete a proof phrase. Reintroduce the partner and finish on a wider synchronized ensemble state.

quick_start.input_format: Overall establishment + thematic focus + subthematic return + group rhythm continuity + return to the final state of the ensemble
quick_start.recommended_input: The whole machine workshop first establishes a rhythm. The camera focuses on the tool movements of the pink main station. The sub-main station then returns and takes over, and finally returns to the panorama to show that all workbenches are running synchronously.
required_anchors: Establish the full ensemble and surrounding response field before isolating a lead.
Bring two central contributors into one shared action before ownership narrows.
Reintroduce the co-lead before the ending.
Finish wide enough to show the ensemble responding in one synchronized state.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish the full ensemble and its shared rhythm, bring two central contributors into one action, then isolate one lead long enough to complete a proof phrase. Reintroduce the partner and finish on a wider synchronized ensemble state.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish a complete ensemble and its audience or work field, bring two central contributors into a shared action, isolate one lead long enough for a complete proof phrase while the ensemble remains spatially implied, then reintroduce the co-lead and finish on a wider synchronized group state.

invariants.rule: Establish the full ensemble and surrounding response field before isolating a lead.
invariants.ablation_failure: Opening close hides the ensemble stakes.

invariants.rule: Bring two central contributors into one shared action before ownership narrows.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate solo gives no handoff.

invariants.rule: Give one lead enough uninterrupted screen ownership to complete a proof phrase.
Reintroduce the co-lead before the ending.
invariants.purpose: Returns focus from individual to partnership.
invariants.ablation_failure: A solo-only ending abandons the opening pair.

invariants.rule: Finish wide enough to show the ensemble responding in one synchronized state.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending close loses the group payoff.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair whose role is clear without source identity.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A materially new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific location.

slots.name: causal_carrier
slots.constraint: One object, route, mark or device that visibly carries the causal chain.

slots.name: state_change
slots.constraint: Five ordered states with observable handoffs, not a decorative montage.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: A new proof-oriented information order that does not copy source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A held final consequence that resolves or recontextualizes the setup.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of story-world cues supporting each visible change.

anti_copy_exclusions: source retro male singers and band
the exact rock performance blocking and wardrobe
